{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Diagnostic

|descr= Add a "bullet camera" to shots fired by the specified unit.

|s1= unit call [[BIS_fnc_diagBulletCam]]

|p1= unit: [[Object]] - the shooting unit. Can be a vehicle.

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] when done

|x1= <sqf>player call BIS_fnc_diagBulletCam;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
// bullet camera will be removed after 10s
_unit = player;
_unit call BIS_fnc_diagBulletCam;
_ehIndex = _unit getVariable "BIS_fnc_diagBulletCam_fired";
sleep 10;
_unit removeEventHandler ["fired", _ehIndex];
</sqf>

|seealso= [[:Category:Event_Handlers|Event Handlers]] [[:Category:Command_Group:_Camera_Control|Camera Control Commands]]
}}
